description: Suijin OS v6.7.0 — The Hardening Release. The run loop cannot die: the provider-restart latch is real (state carried, behaviorally tested), Ctrl+C always pauses (never ends), malformed events degrade to skips, model-authored waits are clamped off the event loop, ask_operator holds the graph at its checkpoint, and a fuzz harness drives hostile streams to prove every run ends classified. THE TOOL-VISIBILITY FIX: the evidence engine (http_replay, inject_probe, web_session, coverage_check, dispatch_testers, surface_expand, bypass_403, code_harness), the POC verifier (catalog_exploit) and the engagement memory (memory_recall) are in the model's tool list again — the catalog diet had silently dropped them and the agent reported 'that tool doesn't exist'. The POC system v3: per-exploit folders (finding.md + exploit.yaml), the verifier takes over the run loop (numbered command panels, black-box output, AI paused, input box live), full transcript + THREE options on miss (edit the yaml / rewrite / worked-anyway with a verified evidence line). Session memory: the librarian daemon catalogs credentials, leaks, footholds and confirmed exploits pattern-first, surfaces them the moment a matching target appears, and the ledger rides .sje resumes; what_worked/prior-confirmed memory revived from a masked dead-reader bug. Context-window awareness: models.dev catalog fetch (1M fallback), window-scaled embed and compaction budgets, output headroom guard, live ctx% gauge. The token diet: catalog one-liners (-48%), head+tail result digests at 8k, task-scoped subagent tool references (-90% of fireteam input), byte-stable prompt head for prefix caching. Providers: 48 rows incl. 13 Chinese platforms (Zhipu, Moonshot, Qwen intl+CN, Volcengine, StepFun, SiliconFlow, Xiaomi MiMo, Meituan LongCat...) + `suijin custom` (any base URL, any key, no validation). The Textual Settings TUI replaces curses (typed editors, 54 providers, echo-proof save). CLI verbs can't traceback (guarded dispatch + classify_and_handle); containers survive bind-mounted config directories. The stream contract: dim reasoning vs BRIGHT cyan markdown speech with syntax-highlighted code boxes (the pad=False silent-fallback bug is dead), smooth typewriter pacing restored (visual cap 320cps, backlog escape 1400). Rich-styled status leaderboard and workspace views. /findings, /h1 (HackerOne clipboard), /out recall. 2,244+ tests green.
